ohm-and-bit.sentence: A Deepcask storage outage broke apps and websites on Friday morning, leaving images missing and uploads stuck.
The outage lasted 2 hours and 10 minutes.
The cause was physical rather than digital: a cooling failure at Deepcask's Ohio data center.
To protect the drives, Deepcask shut down 1,800 storage servers.
Deepcask says no customer data was lost.

byteward.sentence: An outage at cloud storage provider Deepcask left apps and websites unable to load files for part of Friday morning.
The company blamed a cooling failure at its data center in Ohio.
The photo app Shutterkin and the design tool Layloft were among the services that couldn't open files.
Deepcask says it will publish a full incident report within 14 days.
